text: The accepted prefTrue and prefFalse tests separately check prefHasUserValue and prefHasDefaultValue, then exercise single matching values, multiple matching values, one opposite value and one unset value. They clear their created user preferences afterward. For this test family, recommend establishing true absence explicitly; merely clearing a user value can leave a default and test a different state. This is scoped test guidance, not a rule for every preference test. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.
title: Preference-filter tests assert absence on both preference branches
